div.p: Separation of concerns, enforced architecturally, not by policy: a profile's credentials and MCP tools are resolved from its own scope and never unioned into a shared environment (Hermes' own guarantee). This is logical isolation inside one shared container filesystem, not a hardened security boundary — a code-exec bug in one profile's tool could in principle reach another profile's files.
Adding a new agent = new Discord bot app (manual) + new Key Vault secret + new ExternalSecret + new profile config/SOUL + own gateway process (hermes profile use <name> && hermes gateway start).
All eight profiles follow a <role>_<domain> naming pattern

Memory is the one shared backend: all eight live agents point at the same Hindsight service (NAS, docker-compose), but each uses its own bank_id (hermes-<profile>) — recall never crosses banks, so this doesn't violate the isolation model above.
